comments.note: The Output Template in ledger-wp-decomposer.md uses a single fenced code block for the entire template (WP definitions + Plan AC Coverage table). This works but means the Plan AC Coverage table shares the same Markdown code fence as the per-WP sections — a reader scanning the raw template might not immediately see the boundary between 'last WP' and 'coverage table'. Consider splitting into two fenced blocks with a prose note between them in a future pass for clarity. Out of scope for this WP.

In 1-planner.md the instruction for AC numbering appears inline inside the fenced code block (as a plain-text paragraph above the AC lines). Other sections in the template use prose annotations outside the code fence (e.g., '{Optional — omit…}'). For consistency with the surrounding template style, the instruction could be placed outside the fence as an explanatory note rather than embedded content. Low priority — both styles are unambiguous to a reading agent.
